M14_having_sync._note: HAVING evaluated synchronously again: EXISTS throws, the catch drops every group (form 4 over groups). ASK and SELECT agree (both drop) ⇒ the differential stays green.

M15_having_error_fails_query._note: An error in a HAVING condition fails the whole query instead of dropping the group (37c80e59 U4 holds the same for HAVING without EXISTS). Spec stage: also A26 — its HAVING with EXISTS under arithmetic errs (a8012c4f); dropping the group keeps parity with FILTER, failing the query does not.

M16_having_first_condition_only._note: The loop stops after the first HAVING condition whatever it answered (A18).

M21_having_last_condition_decides._note: Review X1: the loop never stops early, so the LAST HAVING condition decides; a false condition followed by a true one keeps the group (A18b). The pre-fix `every` was right.
